package.description: CLI for Copia — source control for industrial automation

en-US.description: CLI for Copia — source control for industrial automation
en-US.longDescription:
copia-cli is a command-line interface for Copia, the source control platform
for industrial automation. Modeled after GitHub CLI (gh), it provides a familiar
interface for managing repositories, issues, pull requests, releases, and more.
en-US.name: copia-cli
